benchmark.lessons: 64 development fixes + 40 QuixBugs fixes, each once; a scored bug's own fix is never among its lessons
benchmark.name: HumanEvalFix (Python split of HumanEvalPack)

limits: One corpus, one split, one producer, one machine.
Correct means behaviourally equal to the published fix on the probe library used.
The refusal path is covered by 15 mechanism tests, not observed on this corpus.
1 bug hit a memory limit in a sharded run and was measured alone; 1 (Python/156) did not finish. Both reported, not folded in.
terminal_authority is false everywhere; no capability is registered and no weights are updated.
note: v2: reconciled with ONE_DEMONSTRATION_LEAVES_TEN_BITS_20261116_V1.md. The selector now uses maximum elimination (correct when the oracle is known correct) instead of the kernel's minimax, which is the right rule only when the answer is unknown. Re-measured on this corpus both rules ask the same 9 questions, because only 2-3 behaviour classes survive the test screen; the elimination gain appears in the ~13,000-program regime measured in that note.
